answer_2.quote: We evaluate pretrained V&L models on VALSE using accuracy (acc), precision (p_c), foil precision (p_f), pairwise ranking accuracy (acc_r), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC)...

answer_3.quote: We use the NLI model ALBERT ... to label the entailment relationship between caption and foil pairs, keeping only pairs labelled as contradiction.

answer_4.quote: Annotators were shown the image, the caption and the foil and asked to determine which of the two texts accurately describes what could be seen in the image.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators chose between five options: a) first but not second, b) second but not first, c) both, d) neither, e) I cannot tell.
